items.Sentence: Domestic wastewater is initially treated by individual 1,000-gallon septic tanks located on each residential property.
The effluent from septic tanks is pumped into the sewer collection system and then into one of two wetwells and the sand filters.
The west wetwell is 1,500 gallons in capacity and the east wetwell is 2,000 gallons in capacity.
The IRVS wastewater collection and treatment facilities consist of septic tanks, small diameter pressure collection system, influent wet wells, two sand filter beds, and two leachfields.
Effluent from each sand filter drains through perforated piping located at the base of the bed where the water is then pumped to the associated subsurface leachfield.
When required, solids in the septic tanks are pumped by the Discharger and hauled to CCWD’s Forest Meadows Wastewater Treatment Plant for additional treatment, dewatering, and disposal.
